brief:
The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported that Israeli settlers have carried out 377 attacks on olive harvest across the West Bank, marking the highest number recorded since 2006, according to Middle East Eye. The surge represents a significant escalation in violence targeting Palestinian agricultural activities during the harvest season.

The attacks disrupt a critical economic activity for Palestinian communities, many of whom depend on the annual olive harvest for income and sustenance. Olive cultivation remains central to the Palestinian rural economy and food security.

title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank olive harvest at record pace, UN reports
